title: Can Copilot Fix It?
subtitle: GitHub agentic autofix
topic: An elegant security-repair workshop on a floating contribution-graph platform. The single hero object is a large translucent glass shield with a visible fracture being joined by a luminous violet precision repair seam. A small coral-red alert crystal enters from one side, while an emerald inspection ring on the other side checks the repaired shield. A subtle curved trail links detection, repair and verification in a loop. The shield must retain a visible seam: an attempted repair awaiting verification, not a promise of perfect security. Strong sculptural silhouette, polished glass and dark metal, three focal objects only, no characters or robots
palette: near-black #101411 and charcoal neutrals with GitHub green #0FBF3E and Copilot purple #8534F3 glowing accents
